subject: Money
title: Too Good to Be True
description: A fast breakdown of Too Good to Be True for builders.

hook.text: Bitconnect promised 1% daily returns—365% per year guaranteed. Peak market cap: $3.4 billion. It was a Ponzi scheme.

buildup.text: Crypto Ponzis disguise themselves as yield platforms, lending protocols, or staking pools. New money pays old investors.

discovery.text: Red flags: guaranteed returns, vague technology explanations, referral bonuses, and pressure to recruit new investors.

twist.text: Celsius, a crypto lender with $12 billion in deposits, collapsed in 2022. Users who chased 8% yields lost billions.

climax.text: In crypto, if someone promises guaranteed high returns, they're either confused or lying. Risk-free returns don't exist.
